Package bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.test

Class BookingMySQLDAOTest

java.lang.Object
bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.test.BookingMySQLDAOTest
@TestMethodOrder(org.junit.jupiter.api.MethodOrderer.OrderAnnotation.class) class BookingMySQLDAOTest extends Object
Comprehensive test class for BookingMySQLDAO Tests all CRUD operations, data persistence, and booking-specific functionality This version works with the ORIGINAL BookingDAO interface (no FlightBookingSystem parameter)
Version:
1.0 - Compatible with original DAO interface
Author:
Tejindra Rai
